description: Sector dollar volume for US stocks: how much traded in each sector (trading volume in US dollars) over the latest session or the last 5 or 20 sessions, ranked by dollar volume, with each sector's share of the market's total and, for the latest session, its dollar volume versus normal (× its prior 20 sessions). Sector totals only: no prices or price changes.

window.description: Sessions summed: 1d, 5d or 20d (or a number of sessions, a week or a month). Default 1d (the latest session).

name: infinity_sector_volume
title: Sector dollar volume
